Lemma
[Young's inequality with $\epsilon $] ↗ lem:youngs-inequality 1. appB:B.2-d\group Elementary Inequalities

Let $1<p,q<\infty $ satisfy $p^{-1}+q^{-1}=1$. For $a,b>0$ and $\epsilon >0$, \[ (7)\qquad ab\leq \epsilon a^p+C(\epsilon )b^q \qquad (a,b>0), \] where \[ C(\epsilon )=(\epsilon p)^{-q/p}q^{-1}. \]
Proof

\sketch Apply (6) to $(\epsilon p)^{1/p}a$ and $b/(\epsilon p)^{1/p}$.

□
